page.layout: One column of running text, set in full lines. Running head at the top. Handwritten marginalia in the right margin, which is not printed text and is left out. Signature at the foot.

main_text.p: qui voluntate populi Ro-rem gratam & æquam per-vim egerit. Hoc autem ex-emplum ex Ciceronis Par-titionibus sumptum est. sed optimum exemplum pro-fertur ab eodem libro de In-vent. II. An pupillaris sub-stitutio vulgarem tacitè, ac vi ipsa contineat. Mæuius heredem fecit, eíque pupil-lariter substituit, hoc modo: Filius meus heres esto: si fi-lius meus autem ante mo-riatur, quàm in tutelam su-am venerit, Titius heres e-sto. Dum pupillus heres est, bona quædam adventitia, hoc est aliunde q̃ à patre, ei obue-

page.notes: The page number "156" is hard to read in the scan and is marked [?]. The "q̃" before "à patre" is printed as an abbreviation and is kept as printed. The handwritten marks in the upper right margin are not printed and are left out. The word "obue-" is broken at the foot of the page and continues on the next page. Printed "eft" and "efto" were corrected to "est" and "esto", and printed long-s "fi" to "si", following the transcription rules.
